newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Valentine week flower auction sales seen higher.
newsitem.headline: Valentine week flower auction sales seen higher.

text.p: Pre-Valentine's Day trading at the world's largest flower auction at Aalsmeer has been fast and furious, auction spokeswoman Adrienne Langsbergen told Reuters.
Turnover in the five days of the Valentine week is forecast to reach 86 million guilders compared to 70 million guilders in the same period last year, she said in a telephone interview.
Langsbergen said Valentine's Day now rivals Mother's Day as the auction's busiest time of the year.

All sorts of flowers were proving popular with domestic and international buyers, although red has been the dominant colour. Roses, tulips and chrysanthemums were the most popular flowers traded, she added.
The Bloemenveilling Aalsmeer auction covers a 156 acre site near Amsterdam's Schiphol airport.
